Hierarchical Attention Swin-YOLO for Sickle Cell Anemia Detection from Raw Holographic Images

Abstract:

Sickle-cell anemia is an inherited hematological autosomal recessive disease that directly affects red blood cells. It is caused by mutation in Hemoglobin-β gene causing red blood cells to become rigid and “C” shaped or sickle shaped. The sickle cell anemia screening is generally done via High-Performance Liquid Chromatography and gel electrophoresis. This requires trained professionals and chemical labelling. To avoid any chemical labelling, quantitative phase imaging has emerged as reliable technology. However, it relies on computationally heavy numerical reconstruction. Thereby, hindering its real-world application as screening device. This can be resolved by using deep learning methods directly on raw holograms as they have sufficient morphological information. Using this technique, high-throughput label-free screening can be done. Therefore, we propose an advanced multi-scale attention based deep learning algorithm for sickle cell detection from unprocessed holographic images. The proposed model has incorporated a parameter free simple attention, position sensitive attention and hierarchical swin transformer-based attention in You Only Look Once (YOLO) for robust detection of cells into three classes named- Healthy, Normoxia, and Hypoxia. Keywords- Deep Learning, Digital Holographic Imaging, Sickle-cell Anemia, Swin Transformer, You Only Look Once.
